Like most TIFUs this happened a while ago

To cut a long story short I kerbed my tire whilst cruising around with some friends one lunchtime (this was whilst I was young and impressionable at school). Wanting to avoid parental rage I went to a local garage to get the tire changed.

Fast forward an hour we were ready to leave the garage, I start reversing, laughing at something my friend Simon was saying, and fail to notice where I am swinging the car towards....

CRASH, I have managed to smash the front left of my car into the side of the garage's door. Now stuck, a crowd starts gathering. My face is burning in embarrassment as they have to lift the car up in order to dislodge it from the door.

Damage totalled £1100. Garage door no longer shut. Let's just say I was allowed to drive for a long time.

Not an amazing TIFU but had to get the ball rolling!
